item.text:
For Mistral OCR, the supported file formats are:

- PDF
- PNG
- JPG/JPEG
- TIFF
- BMP
- GIF
- WEBP

The maximum individual upload size is **512 MB**. ZIP files are not supported, so a `.zip` upload returns `422 Invalid file format.` Extract the archive and upload each supported PDF/image file separately. [Mistral known limitations](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/known-limitations)

The Files API also documents the **512 MB per-file limit** and `purpose="ocr"` upload workflow. [Files API](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/files)
